response.text: {"verdict": "needs_review", "clause_ids": ["A7.1", "A7.3", "A7.5"], "rationale": "The claim involves a lost camera (a valuable item) during a flight. Clause A7.1 provides coverage for loss of luggage during transport. However, clause A7.3 limits coverage for electronics (like the camera) to 30% of the luggage limit. Clause A7.5 excludes coverage for theft of valuables and electronics left unattended in public places. The evidence does not clarify whether the camera was left unattended or if it was part of the lost luggage. Therefore, the claim needs further review to determine if the exclusion in A7.5 applies."}
